Produces: Infinite surveil; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers
Start: Dualcaster Mage (hand); Afterlife from the Loam (hand); Umbral Collar Zealot (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
  Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
  When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
  Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
  Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
  Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 3.

Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.

  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Mortuary (battlefield); Falkenrath Noble (battlefield); Bolas's Citadel (battlefield); Goblin Firestarter (battlefield)
